commit_message:
[Merged] Replace the hash table borrowed from fts3.

FossilOrigin-Name: 617e2fac1c128212254f71b1a8fddaf0d1d90262
pr_title: Use a dedicated hash table for FTS5 term accumulation
pr_description: Replace the hash table borrowed from FTS3 with a dedicated FTS5 implementation for accumulating term and document-list data. Calculate entry growth using 64-bit arithmetic and reject sizes beyond the realloc API's signed integer range with SQLITE_NOMEM.

 int sqlite3Fts5IndexReads(Fts5Index *p);
 
 /*
 ** End of interface to code in fts5_index.c.

+/**************************************************************************
+** Interface to code in fts5_hash.c.

+typedef struct Fts5Hash Fts5Hash;

+** Create a hash table, free a hash table.

+int sqlite3Fts5HashNew(Fts5Hash**, int *pnSize);

+** Empty (but do not delete) a hash table.

+
+/*
+** End of interface to code in fts5_hash.c.

intro_commit_message:
Replace the hash table borrowed from fts3.

FossilOrigin-Name: 617e2fac1c128212254f71b1a8fddaf0d1d90262
fix_commit_message:
Avoid a possible integer overflow when fts5 tokenizes a very large document. Only possible with non-standard builds that use large values of SQLITE_MAX_LENGTH. Bug [bugs:/info/2026-06-09T05:27:16Z | 2026-06-09T05:27:16Z].

FossilOrigin-Name: d562e91374e2bebcf75a00776b4def532bb71914a07e37c8507f7a5918db1d3b
agent_reasoning: The entry allocation size is an int, so doubling it in 32-bit arithmetic could overflow before conversion. The on-disk code casts the operand to i64 before multiplying and stores the result in sqlite3_int64. This older snapshot lacks sqlite3_realloc64, so a range check rejects sizes above 0x7fffffff before narrowing for sqlite3_realloc, avoiding an invalid allocation request while preserving the existing entry on failure. Only ext/fts5/fts5_hash.c was edited; tests and Fossil metadata were left unchanged. Workspace validation passed against intro_parent.
